final: SELECT AVG(genre_avg_price), AVG(genre_avg_ratio), AVG(genre_avg_ratio - overall_avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT GenreId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS genre_avg_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS genre_avg_ratio FROM Track GROUP BY GenreId) AS genre_stats CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(genre_avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS genre_avg_ratio FROM Track GROUP BY GenreId)) AS overall_stats WHERE genre_avg_ratio > overall_avg_ratio
